title: Tumbler Toothbrush Holder Wall Mount Solid Brass 4.5-Inch | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Brass Toothbrush Holders | Allied Brass
description:
Stop losing counter space to loose cups and toothbrushes in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. This wall-mounted tumbler toothbrush holder (also called a toothbrush tumbler holder or wall tumbler holder) keeps daily essentials organized and easy to reach in the bathroom.

Highlights:
- Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Cleaner look on the wall—concealed screw mounting hardware keeps fasteners out of sight
- Coordinate matching accessories—part of the Brass Toothbrush Holders collection with multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Wall mounted tumbler and toothbrush holder
- Material: Solid brass
- Mounting: Concealed screw wall-mount hardware included
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 x 4.7 x 3.5 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 6 x 6 x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 3 lbs
- Assembly: Assembled in the U.S.A.

Style notes: A smart fit for transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories.
